prompt.content: What was the peak position of the Who's That Girl soundtrack on the UK Albums Chart in 1987?

output:
The peak position of the "Who's That Girl" soundtrack on the UK Albums Chart in 1987 was **No. 2**.

This chart peak occurred in the week ending March 28, 1987, according to the official UK Singles Chart data. The soundtrack peaked at No. 2, just behind the original single
